kind: posthoc descriptive analysis of exploratory protocol-deviation run; not preregistered
rule: Select 170 event=typed_observation rows in recorded order; compare each adjacent pair for frame_rgb_sha256 inequality and typed health/ammo numeric equality/inequality.
limits: A14 is a protocol deviation and exploratory only.
No correlation with cover-active intervals or planner-wait intervals is computed.
Full-frame hash change is not semantic threat evidence.
No causal, safety, policy-quality, recovery, or task-success inference.
purpose: Quantify how often whole-frame hashes change while the two typed HUD readings remain stable in this retained trace; assess only whether a naive whole-frame hash trigger would be indiscriminate.
